description: This file defines the MarkBased class, which extends RegexBasedAbstract, and is part of the FastRoute routing library. It handles processing of route data, creating regex patterns with mark names, and mapping routes.

classes.name: MarkBased
classes.description: A class that extends RegexBasedAbstract and is responsible for processing regex-to-route mappings by generating regex patterns with marks and creating corresponding route maps.

methods.name: getApproxChunkSize
methods.description: Returns an approximate chunk size used in processing, fixed at 30.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes a chunk of regex to route mappings, appending mark names to regexes and creating a route map keyed by mark name.
